integrations._comment: Optional MCP servers that enhance skills. Skills auto-detect availability.
integrations.firecrawl: If configured, /research and /scout use Firecrawl instead of WebFetch for better JS rendering and cleaner markdown. Setup: https://docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp
integrations.stitch: If configured, /frame generates UI screens via Google Stitch. Setup: add stitch MCP to .claude/settings.json
